verdict.rationale: Companies House is a government company registry with a public REST API and filing and search web services. It is not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client or AI tool-calling capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
